{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert 'revenue' column to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
df['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Check if any conversion errors occurred
print('Number of rows with invalid revenue:', df['revenue'].isna().sum())

# Confirm the dtype is now float64
print('New dtype of revenue:', df['revenue'].dtype)"}
